newsitem.title: USA: Halliburton, Petroleum Engineering in deal.
newsitem.headline: Halliburton, Petroleum Engineering in deal.

text.p: Halliburton Energy Services, a unit of Halliburton Co, said on Monday it and Petroleum Engineering Services Ltd had signed a letter of intent to set up an alliance for the development and delivery of intelligent completion systems.
The company said in a statement that the systems, sometimes called "smart wells," will enable oil and gas companies to evaluate and control individual zones without well intervention.
This can significantly reduce operating expenditures by reducing down time and enable "enhanced hydrocarbon recovery through better reservoir management."
